name: LXC Network Share Manager
description: Add NFS or SMB/CIFS shares on the Proxmox host and map them into LXC containers. Includes IP validation, conflict detection, read-only options, safe permission handling, fstab backups, profiles, scheduling, and a CLI mode for install scripts.

notes.text: Run this tool on the Proxmox host as root.
For unprivileged containers, host UID/GID mapping uses +100000.
A backup of /etc/fstab is created before changes.
Permission changes are optional and default to no changes.
Conflict detection warns if a host path is already in use.
